title: Braised Cherry Tomato Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired stew made with tender cherry tomatoes and a rich braising liquid.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Add the stew, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise the stew in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the tomatoes are tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil.
Serve hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
